This Refund & Cancellation Policy explains the terms under which refunds, returns, and order cancellations are handled by Buyavdeals.online (“Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). By placing an order on https://buyavdeals.online, you agree to the conditions outlined below.

Buyavdeals.online operates as an independent reseller of antivirus software, digital licenses, and computer/peripheral devices within the United States.

Buyavsdeals is owned and operated by AllRoundFix LLC, a company committed to delivering reliable products, transparent pricing, and a secure online shopping experience.

Order Cancellation

Before Order Processing

Orders may be canceled before they are processed or dispatched. If you wish to cancel an order, please contact us immediately after placing the order.

Once processing begins, cancellation may not be possible.

After Order Processing

  • Orders that have already been processed, shipped, or digitally delivered cannot be canceled.
  • Digital products are considered processed once delivery of the license key or activation details has occurred.

Refund Eligibility

Refund eligibility depends on the type of product purchased:

Digital Products (Antivirus Software & License Keys)

  • Refunds are not guaranteed for digital products once the license key or activation details have been delivered.
  • Refund requests may be considered only if:
    • The license key is proven to be invalid at the time of delivery, and
    • The product has not been activated or used.

Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of purchase.

Physical Products (Peripheral Devices)

  • Physical products may be eligible for return if:
    • The item is defective, damaged, or incorrect upon delivery
    • The return request is submitted within 7 days of delivery

Returned items must be unused and in original packaging, unless the item arrived damaged or defective.

Non-Refundable Items

The following are not eligible for refunds:

  • Activated or used digital antivirus licenses
  • Downloaded digital products
  • Items damaged due to misuse, negligence, or unauthorized modifications
  • Clearance or promotional items marked as non-refundable

Return Process (Physical Products)

To request a return:

  1. Contact our support team with your order details.
  2. Wait for return authorization and instructions.
  3. Ship the item as instructed.

Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the return is due to our error.

Refund Processing Time

  • Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method.
  • Refund processing time may take 5–10 business days, depending on your payment provider.

Exchanges

We may offer replacements or exchanges for defective or incorrect physical products, subject to availability.

Chargebacks & Payment Disputes

If you believe there is a billing issue, please contact us before initiating a chargeback. Unauthorized or unjustified chargebacks may result in order cancellation or account restrictions.

Subscription & Renewal Cancellations (If Applicable)

For antivirus subscriptions:

  • Auto-renewal subscriptions must be canceled before the renewal date.
  • Charges made after renewal may not be refundable.

Policy Updates

We reserve the right to update or modify this Refund & Cancellation Policy at any time. Any changes will be effective once posted on the Website with a revised “Last Updated” date.

Contact Information

For questions regarding refunds, returns, or cancellations, please contact us:
